_note: SYNTHETIC DATA. Tamarind Pay is a fictional payments company invented for this demo. All names, services, hosts, IPs and incidents are made up but modelled on common production failure modes. Timestamps are IST (+05:30).

incidents.title: SMS/OTP notifications delayed 20+ minutes
incidents.log_excerpt:
ERROR c.t.notif.OtpHandler - Failed to deserialize record offset=88412093 partition=7: com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.exc.MismatchedInputException: Cannot deserialize value of type `java.lang.String` from Object value (token `JsonToken.START_OBJECT`)
WARN  o.a.k.c.c.internals.ConsumerCoordinator - Retrying record offset=88412093 (attempt 412)
incidents.root_cause: A poison message from a new producer (merchant-portal v3.2 sent `phone` as an object) blocked partition 7. The handler retried forever with no dead-letter queue.
incidents.fix: Skipped the offset with `kafka-consumer-groups --reset-offsets --to-offset 88412094 --partition 7`, then shipped a DLQ (notifications.otp.dlq) with max 5 retries.
incidents.did_not_work: Scaling notif-worker from 6 to 12 replicas did nothing: lag is per-partition and partition 7 stayed blocked.

incidents.title: payments-api 502s during evening UPI peak
incidents.alert: HighErrorRate: payments-api 5xx ratio 23.4% (SLO 0.5%) for 5m; upstream envoy: 'upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers'
incidents.log_excerpt:
ERROR com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool - HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms (total=40, active=40, idle=0, waiting=212)
WARN  pgbouncer: closing because: query_wait_timeout (age=120s) db=ledger user=payments
incidents.root_cause: ledger-svc deploy 4.18.0 ran a migration (`ALTER TABLE ledger.entries ADD COLUMN settlement_ref text NOT NULL DEFAULT ''`) that took an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock on ledger.entries. payments-api queries queued behind the lock and exhausted the Hikari pool (40) and PgBouncer pool.
incidents.fix: Found the blocking PID with `SELECT pid, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE wait_event_type='Lock'` and ran `SELECT pg_terminate_backend(<pid>)` on the migration. Rolled ledger-svc back to 4.17.2. Error rate recovered in ~4 minutes.
incidents.did_not_work: Restarting payments-api pods bought ~8 minutes, then the pool filled again. HPA scale-out from 8 to 16 pods made it WORSE: more pods = more connections against PgBouncer max_client_conn=800.

incidents.title: checkout.tamarindpay.example returning 526 from CDN
incidents.alert: SyntheticCheckFailed: GET https://checkout.tamarindpay.example/health -> 526 Invalid SSL certificate (3/3 regions)
incidents.log_excerpt:
cert-manager: Failed to create Order: 429 urn:ietf:params:acme:error:rateLimited: too many certificates already issued for exact set of domains
Certificate checkout-origin-tls not Ready: secret expired at 2026-09-29T05:30:00Z
incidents.root_cause: The origin TLS cert expired. cert-manager renewals had been failing for 9 days because a misconfigured staging namespace was also requesting the same cert set and burned the ACME rate limit.
incidents.fix: Temporarily switched CDN origin SSL mode to 'Full' (not strict) for 30 min, deleted the duplicate Certificate in staging, renewed via the DNS-01 issuer. Added a CertificateExpiringSoon alert at 14 days.
incidents.did_not_work: Re-running the cert-manager Order immediately kept hitting the 429 rate limit.

incidents.title: Merchants logged out; 401s on token validation
incidents.log_excerpt: WARN  jwt.validate kid=ks-2026-10 not found in JWKS cache (cached kids: ks-2026-07, ks-2026-04); cache_age=21h
incidents.root_cause: Signing keys were rotated at 15:30 but auth-gateway caches JWKS for 24h and does not refetch on unknown kid.
incidents.fix: Rolling restart of auth-gateway to flush JWKS cache; patched gateway to refetch JWKS on unknown kid (rate-limited to once per 60s).
incidents.did_not_work: Rolling back the key rotation was considered but would have invalidated tokens already issued with the new key.

incidents.title: search-indexer CrashLoopBackOff, merchant search stale
incidents.log_excerpt:
Last State: Terminated  Reason: OOMKilled  Exit Code: 137
java.lang.OutOfMemoryError: Java heap space at o.e.c.xcontent.XContentBuilder
incidents.root_cause: A mapping change added a nested `line_items` field; full reindex batches of 5,000 docs exceeded the 2Gi limit.
incidents.fix: Dropped bulk batch size to 500 via INDEXER_BULK_SIZE and raised memory limit to 3Gi; resumed from checkpoint.
incidents.did_not_work: Raising -Xmx without raising the container limit just made the kernel OOM-kill sooner.

incidents.title: p99 latency spike on payments-api (DNS)
incidents.log_excerpt: coredns: [ERROR] plugin/errors: 2 ledger-svc.payments.svc.cluster.local.payments.svc.cluster.local. A: read udp 10.4.2.17:53122->10.4.0.10:53: i/o timeout
incidents.root_cause: ndots:5 caused 4 extra search-domain lookups per call; CoreDNS was CPU-throttled after a node pool change.
incidents.fix: Set dnsConfig ndots:2 on payments-api, used FQDN with trailing dot for ledger-svc, raised CoreDNS CPU limit.
incidents.did_not_work: Restarting CoreDNS pods helped for ~3 minutes only.

incidents.title: Carts emptied for logged-in users
incidents.alert: BusinessMetricDrop: checkout_started per minute down 41% vs same hour last week
incidents.log_excerpt:
redis: # WARNING maxmemory reached; evicted_keys=1,284,330 (policy allkeys-lru)
checkout-web: session sess:9f1c... not found, issuing new anonymous cart
incidents.root_cause: Session Redis hit maxmemory (6GB) after a marketing campaign; allkeys-lru evicted live session keys.
incidents.fix: Moved cart state to the durable carts table; set session Redis to volatile-lru with TTLs; bumped maxmemory to 10GB.
incidents.did_not_work: FLUSHDB was proposed in channel and rejected: it would have logged everyone out.

incidents.title: payments-api 502s again after ledger-svc deploy
incidents.log_excerpt:
ERROR com.zaxxer.hikari.pool.HikariPool - HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms (total=40, active=40, idle=0, waiting=187)
LOG:  process 48211 still waiting for AccessExclusiveLock on relation 16502 of database ledger after 1000.112 ms
incidents.root_cause: Same pattern as INC-2041: ledger-svc 4.21.0 migration created an index without CONCURRENTLY on ledger.entries, holding a lock during evening peak.
incidents.fix: Priya paged in, terminated the migration backend with pg_terminate_backend, rolled ledger-svc back to 4.20.3. Action item: ledger-svc migrations must set `lock_timeout = '3s'` and use CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY; deploy freeze for ledger-svc 19:00-22:00 IST.
incidents.did_not_work: Arjun first restarted payments-api pods (recovered for 6 minutes) and then scaled the HPA (made PgBouncer saturation worse) before paging Priya. Cost ~20 minutes.

incidents.title: Email receipts not sent (SES throttling)
incidents.log_excerpt: ERROR ses.send: ThrottlingException: Maximum sending rate exceeded. (rate=14/s)
incidents.root_cause: Batch settlement job sent 40k receipts at 03:30 at full speed; SES account limit is 14 emails/s.
incidents.fix: Added token-bucket limiter at 12/s in notif-worker; requested SES quota increase.

incidents.title: Settlement reconciliation job stuck
incidents.log_excerpt:
LOG: duration: 11532012.441 ms  statement: SELECT ... FROM ledger.entries e JOIN ledger.settlements s ON s.ref = e.settlement_ref WHERE ...
autovacuum: found 41% dead tuples in ledger.entries
incidents.root_cause: Missing index on ledger.entries(settlement_ref) plus table bloat; planner chose a seq scan.
incidents.fix: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY idx_entries_settlement_ref; manual VACUUM (ANALYZE) ledger.entries off-peak.

incidents.title: Rate-limit false positives for one large merchant
incidents.alert: Merchant escalation: merchant_id=M-77120 seeing 429 Too Many Requests
incidents.root_cause: Merchant moved behind a shared NAT; IP-based limit grouped all their servers.
incidents.fix: Switched that tier to API-key-based limits (6,000/min).

incidents.title: Brief 5xx blip: PgBouncer pool saturation
incidents.log_excerpt:
pgbouncer: WARNING cl_waiting=96 sv_active=50/50 pool=ledger/payments
ERROR HikariPool-1 - Connection is not available, request timed out after 30000ms (total=40, active=40, idle=0, waiting=58)
incidents.root_cause: A long-running analytics query from the BI read path hit the primary instead of the replica (bad DSN in a new Metabase card), holding server connections.
incidents.fix: Killed the query, pointed Metabase at the replica DSN, added statement_timeout=30s for the bi role.

preferences.text: Priya Raman (payments SRE lead) wants rollback-first answers: give the rollback command before any investigation, and copy-pasteable kubectl/psql commands, not links to dashboards.
Priya Raman asked to be paged immediately for any payments-api SEV1 that shows Hikari pool exhaustion, without waiting for the on-call to try restarts.
Arjun Mehta joined on-call in September and prefers step-by-step instructions with one line explaining why each step matters, plus a 'how to verify it worked' check after each step.
Neha Kulkarni (platform) owns PgBouncer and CoreDNS and prefers PromQL queries she can paste into Grafana Explore over kubectl output.
Daniel Okafor (checkout) wants every customer-impact estimate expressed in failed checkouts per minute, and wants Neha looped in for anything touching Redis or Postgres.

service_facts.text: payments-api: Java 21 / Spring Boot, HikariCP pool size 40 per pod, talks to Postgres 'ledger' through PgBouncer (max_client_conn=800, default_pool_size=50). SLO 99.5% success, p99 < 400ms. Owner: Priya Raman.
ledger-svc: owns the ledger.entries table (~410M rows). Schema migrations run as a pre-deploy Kubernetes Job. Deploy freeze 19:00-22:00 IST since INC-2087. Owner: Priya Raman.
checkout-web: Next.js behind CDN; session store is Redis (volatile-lru). Owner: Daniel Okafor.
notif-worker: Kafka consumer for notifications.* topics, 12 partitions, DLQ notifications.otp.dlq. Owner: Neha Kulkarni.
auth-gateway: Envoy + Go ext_authz; JWKS refetch on unknown kid since INC-2058. Owner: Neha Kulkarni.
search-indexer: Java bulk indexer into OpenSearch, INDEXER_BULK_SIZE=500, memory limit 3Gi. Owner: Arjun Mehta.
